activeRecallQuiz.scenario: In an established uptrend, price hits a higher high at ₹720, but the 14-day RSI peaks at 66, failing to reach its prior peak of 78. RSI then drops below its intervening trough of 58. What two powerful signals just coincided?
activeRecallQuiz.question: In an established uptrend, price hits a higher high at ₹720, but the 14-day RSI peaks at 66, failing to reach its prior peak of 78. RSI then drops below its intervening trough of 58. What two powerful signals just coincided?
activeRecallQuiz.correctAnswer: Bearish Divergence (Price higher high vs RSI lower high) AND a Top Failure Swing (RSI peak 1 > 70, peak 2 < 70, slicing below trough 58). This is Wilder's ultimate multi-factor sell signal.
activeRecallQuiz.explanation: Applying grounded principles prevents catastrophic losses and capital depletion.

coreTakeaways: Always evaluate underlying market assumptions before entering positions.
